The single source of truth for humans and coding agents (Copilot, Claude,
Cursor, Hermes, etc.) working on Kailash OS —
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/blob/master/AGENTS.md)
in the [`kailash-os`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-os) repository
(default branch `master`). A companion file covers the
[`kailash-packages`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-packages)
overlay repo:
[`AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-packages/blob/main/AGENTS.md).
Tool-specific files (`CLAUDE.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`) point
there; when anything disagrees, **AGENTS.md wins**.

This page is a **verbatim render** of that file; the synced copy lives at
[`includes/AGENTS.md`](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-website/blob/main/includes/AGENTS.md)
(resync = `curl -o includes/AGENTS.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kailash-os/kailash-os/master/AGENTS.md`).
